title: Rollers
description: Plant-hire industrial: a white page ruled into cells by charcoal hairlines, charcoal ink and bands, one loud safety orange for half of every headline and the CTAs, an olive grey for quiet text and hovers, and a denim-blue band with navy accents. A geometric grotesk for headings and text, a Helvetica-style grotesk for statements and big figures; 3px corners and pills, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with the charcoal as the page, and it is also the palette the charcoal bands use (they set the dark class on themselves)
secondary is the charcoal of the pill buttons and chips (olive in dark); muted-foreground is the olive grey of quiet paragraphs and every button's hover
accent is the denim-blue band, highlight its navy second headline line
radius is 3px (the orange buttons); page-width is 100% with a 30px gutter on phones and 40px from 768px
sets an extra --typeface-grotesk (Arimo) that rollers blocks read for statements and figures, falling back to the body face
name: rollers-theme
